title: Deferral Rate Schedule by Loan Seasoning — Home Purchase Financing
content:
**Deferral rate schedule — Home Purchase Financing deferment fees**

The deferral rate is the percentage of the scheduled installment charged as the deferral charge of a deferment fee. Where the loan's first installment fell due 60 or more whole months before the signing date, the deferral rate is 0.50 percent; where it fell due 36 to 59 whole months before, the deferral rate is 0.75 percent. Where it fell due fewer than 36 whole months before, no reduced rate applies under this schedule.

The first installment's due date is the first payment date on the loan record.

| Whole months from the first installment's due date to the signing date | Deferral rate |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.50 percent |
| 36 to 59 | 0.75 percent |
| fewer than 36 | no reduced rate |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical signing date 2026-04-10)

| First installment due | Whole months | Deferral rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2021-04-01 | 60 | 0.50 percent |
| 2021-05-01 | 59 | 0.75 percent |
| 2023-04-01 | 36 | 0.75 percent |
| 2023-05-01 | 35 | no reduced rate |

*Hypothetical figure.* On a scheduled installment of 705.00 with one installment deferred, a 0.50 percent rate gives a deferral charge of 3.525, rounded half up to 3.53.
